Subject: Final logistics — Sapphire CEO Roundtable (Wed 16 Sep)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as the technology partner for our CEO roundtable next Wednesday (16 Sep). A few last-minute logistical questions from our side so we can prep the EAs and the on-site security team:

- Arrival window for your delegation: ETA window and lead EA contact?
- Headcount for the green room (private prep space) and any AV rehearsals needed the morning of?
- Dietary restrictions for the VIP lunch (we'll share final menu with caterer Friday)
- Any credentialing or transit requirements for special hardware?

Also attaching our venue AV spec and a draft guest badge spreadsheet. If you could confirm by EOD Friday it would help our vendor scheduling.

Best,
Maya
Event Producer — Aurora Capital

Subject: Re: Final logistics — Sapphire CEO Roundtable (Wed 16 Sep)

Lauren / Evelyn / Aditya — looping you all in to lock the plan. Quick answers below; I put action owners on each item.

- Arrival window & EA contact: 16 Sep, 09:00–10:30 PT arrival window. Lauren will be the EA lead on-site; her mobile is in the footer. (Action: Lauren — confirm car pickup timings with Aurora by Fri 17:00 PT.)
- Green room + AV rehearsal: We need green room for 8 people + 1 tech for a 30-minute mic/walkthrough at 08:00 on the 16th. (Action: Aditya — confirm AV rehearsal requirements with venue and request a lav mic & wired backup.)
- Dietary restrictions: I have three restrictions to relay — vegetarian + nut allergy (VIP) / pescatarian / halal. (Action: Marissa — confirm final headcount and feed to Maya by EOD Friday.)
- Hardware credentials: We'll bring one encrypted laptop and a drive. Evelyn — please check with security on accelerated badge provisioning.

I'll send a compact day-of playbook after you confirm the two vendor items. Copying Maya for transparency.

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: FINAL: Day-of playbook + attachments — Sapphire CEO Roundtable (16 Sep)

Team — attaching the consolidated day-of playbook and final badge list. This is the live operational doc; please treat this as read-only and comment in Drive if you need edits. Key highlights below, pulled from earlier threads: 

- 06:30 — Markus + delegation depart hotel (Black town car). Lauren to confirm rooming list by 17:00 PT Fri (DONE).
- 07:30 — Green room opens (Room B) / security check-in starts. Evelyn to run badge desk.
- 08:00 — AV rehearsal (10–15 min) with venue tech. Aditya to test laptop/video playback + wired backup.
- 08:30 — Security bridge (15 min) — Evelyn hosting, dial-in + bridge link in Drive doc.
- 09:30 — VIP arrival / staging. 10:00 — Roundtable starts.
- Lunch (12:30) — plated service; Marissa confirmed three dietary notes in badge list.
- Contingency: backup breakout room reserved; if AV fails, we have a laptop + HDMI-to-USB encoder in the kit.

Attachments: sapphire_itinerary_v3.pdf (compact timeline), ea_badge_list_0909.csv, venue_av_spec_0907.docx. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Sapphire_Roundtable/itinerary

If no further changes by EOD Monday I'll forward final copies to Aurora and arrange a 30-minute dry run Monday evening (optional).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
